title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization helps prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. L1 regularization (Lasso) tends to produce sparse models with fewer coefficients, while L2 regularization (Ridge) tends to shrink coefficients evenly. Without regularization, the model is more likely to have larger coefficients.

title: Interpreting Coefficients
